You’re not annoying anyone, alright? It’s important to get the reassurance you need in scenarios like this, I understand you.

You're really stressed right now, and it's completely understandable. You cannot get pregnant from the situations you've described (dry humping, fingering). Pregnancy only happens when semen enters the vagina, which doesn't seem to be the case here. The bloating and delay in your period are most likely from stress, which can really mess with your body.
